Visby merchants and shipowners agreed freight, handovers and responsibility during a voyage. Storm, grounding or damaged cargo brought disputes over crews' reports, delivered quantities and prior terms, potentially harming relationships between partners. Crews and guards maintained vessel and cooperation, with fighting constrained by space. Saving goods and people competed for capacity, requiring explanations of losses afterward.

Storm, grounding or damaged cargo brought disputes over crews' reports, delivered quantities and prior terms, potentially harming relationships between partners. Merchants sharing risk identified vessel, goods and route decisions across ports. Delay affected later payments, and claims needed an accessible authority.
